title: What does this return?
examObjective: Predicting the result of core DataWeave functions
prompt: Read the script and the payload. **What does it return?**

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ one: payload.order.line, all: payload.order.*line }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ one: payload.order.line, all: payload.order.*line }

explanation.approach: `.*` always returns an Array, even when there is only one matching element. That is why it is the safe selector for an element that may repeat: the code after it does not have to handle two shapes.
